title: Finishing Your Thesis and Working With Your Supervisor

hook.en: Most theses are not late because of hard science. They are late because of unclear plans, silent weeks and a draft nobody has read. A thesis is a project, and a supervisor is a partner in it. Learn how to manage both, kindly and firmly.
hook.ur: Zyada tar theses mushkil science ki wajah se late nahi hoti. Woh ghair-wazeh plans, khamosh haftoon aur aise draft ki wajah se late hoti hain jo kisi ne parha hi nahi. Thesis ek project hai, aur supervisor us mein shareek. Dono ko narmi aur mazbooti se sambhalna seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll plan a thesis backwards from the deadline, run useful supervisor meetings, write a little every week, handle citations and backups, agree authorship early, and prepare for the viva.
goal.ur: End tak aap deadline se peechay ki taraf thesis ka plan banayenge, supervisor ki mufeed mulaqatein chalayenge, har haftay thora likhenge, hawale aur backups sambhalenge, musannifi pehle tay karenge, aur viva ki tayyari karenge.

text.en: A thesis succeeds through **small, steady, visible steps**. Plan **backwards from the deadline**, with time for ethics approval, data collection, analysis, writing and revision. Write **a little every week**, even badly, because a rough draft can be fixed and a blank page cannot. Treat your supervisor as a **busy partner**: arrive prepared, send a short written summary after each meeting and agree the next steps. Use a **reference manager** from the first day.
text.ur: Thesis **chhote, mustaqil, nazar aane wale qadmon** se kamyab hoti hai. **Deadline se peechay ki taraf** plan banayein, ethics ki manzoori, data jama karna, tajziya, likhna aur nazar-e-saani ke liye waqt ke saath. **Har haftay thora likhein**, chahe kharab ho, kyunke kachcha draft theek ho sakta hai aur khali safha nahi. Supervisor ko **masroof shareek** samjhein: tayyar ho kar aayein, har mulaqat ke baad mukhtasar likhi khulasa bhejein aur agle qadam tay karein. Pehle din se **reference manager** istemal karein.

text.en: Think of **building a house**. You do not start with the paint. You plan the foundation, the walls and the roof, set dates, check each stage with the engineer and keep the receipts. The supervisor is the engineer: not a builder who does the work for you, but someone who spots a crack early if you show them the wall.
text.ur: **Ghar banane** ko sochein. Aap rang se shuru nahi karte. Bunyad, deewarein aur chhat ka plan banate hain, tareekhein tay karte hain, har marhale par engineer se jaanch karwate hain aur rasidein rakhte hain. Supervisor engineer hai: aisa mistri nahi jo aap ka kaam kare, balke woh jo deewar dikhane par daraar jaldi pakad leta hai.

title.en: A backwards plan and a meeting routine
title.ur: Peechay ki taraf plan aur mulaqat ki routine

steps.title: Fix the end and work backwards
steps.detail: Write the submission date, then the viva or defence, then the last full draft (4 to 6 weeks before), then analysis, data collection, ethics approval and protocol. Add a spare month for delays. || Aakhir tay karein aur peechay chalein

steps.title: Set the meeting rhythm early
steps.detail: Agree how often you will meet (for example every two weeks), how you will contact each other and how long the supervisor needs to read a draft (often one to two weeks). || Mulaqat ki laya pehle tay karein

steps.title: Prepare a one-page agenda
steps.detail: Send before each meeting: what I did, what I found, where I am stuck, what I need decided. Bring questions, not just problems. || Ek safha ka agenda taiyar karein

steps.title: Send a summary after each meeting
steps.detail: Three lines: what we agreed, who does what, and by when. It prevents misunderstandings and creates a record. || Har mulaqat ke baad khulasa bhejein

steps.title: Write weekly and back up
steps.detail: Aim for a small word count each week. Keep three copies of everything (see the data management lesson), and never keep the only copy on a USB stick. || Haftawar likhein aur backup rakhein

question.en: Your supervisor has not replied to your draft for three weeks. What is the best first step?
question.ur: Aap ke supervisor ne teen haftay se aap ke draft ka jawab nahi diya. Behtareen pehla qadam kya hai?

text.en: Send a short, polite reminder referring to the agreed timeline, offer a 15-minute meeting, and keep working on the next section
text.ur: Tay shuda timeline ka hawala dete hue mukhtasar, shaista yaad dahani bhejein, 15 minute ki mulaqat ki peshkash karein, aur agle hissay par kaam jari rakhein

feedback.en: Yes — politeness, a clear request and continued progress usually work.
feedback.ur: Haan — shaistagi, saaf darkhwast aur jari pesh-raft aam taur par kaam karte hain.

text.ur: Deadline tak khamoshi se intezar karein

feedback.ur: Khamoshi der ko mazeed bigaarti hai.

text.en: Complain about the supervisor to other students first
text.ur: Pehle doosre talba se supervisor ki shikayat karein

feedback.en: Raise it with the supervisor before anyone else.
feedback.ur: Pehle supervisor se baat karein, kisi aur se nahi.

question.en: When should you agree on authorship for any paper from the thesis?
question.ur: Thesis se nikalne wale kisi paper ki musannifi kab tay karni chahiye?

text.en: Early, in writing, before the work is done, and revisit it as contributions change
text.ur: Jaldi, likh kar, kaam mukammal hone se pehle, aur jab hissay badlein to dobara dekhein

feedback.en: Yes — early agreement avoids painful disputes.
feedback.ur: Haan — jaldi ittefaq takleef deh jhagron se bachata hai.

text.en: It is decided by seniority alone
text.ur: Sirf senior hone se tay hota hai

feedback.en: It should follow contribution under recognised criteria.
feedback.ur: Tasleem shuda criteria ke tahet hissay se tay hona chahiye.

question.en: Why start a reference manager such as Zotero on day one?
question.ur: Zotero jaisa reference manager pehle din se kyun shuru karein?

text.en: It is needed only for PhDs
text.ur: Yeh sirf PhD ke liye zaroori hai

feedback.ur: Har thesis ko faida hota hai.

text.en: It writes the thesis for you
text.ur: Yeh aap ke liye thesis likh deta hai

feedback.ur: Yeh zariye sambhalta hai, likhna nahi.

text.en: It stores every source with its details, builds citations and the reference list automatically, and prevents last-minute errors and accidental plagiarism
text.ur: Yeh har zariye ko tafseel ke saath rakhta hai, hawale aur reference list khud banata hai, aur aakhri waqt ki ghaltiyon aur ghair irada naqal se bachata hai

feedback.en: Yes — it saves days of work.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh kai din ka kaam bachata hai.

text.en: **Hiding problems and meeting only at the end.** Supervisors can help with a stuck analysis in a week but not with a missing chapter a month before the deadline. Show rough work early. Another trap is copying text without citing it, even by accident; use quotation marks and references from the start, and run the permitted similarity checks. Never fabricate or adjust data: an honest limitation is acceptable, misconduct is not.
text.ur: **Masail chhupana aur sirf aakhir mein milna.** Supervisor atka hua tajziya ek haftay mein theek karwa sakte hain, lekin deadline se ek mahina pehle ghayab chapter mein nahi. Kachcha kaam jaldi dikhayein. Ek aur jaal bina hawale ke text copy karna hai, ghair irada bhi; pehle din se quotation marks aur references istemal karein, aur ijazat shuda similarity checks chalayein. Data kabhi gharein ya badlein nahi: imaandar had qabil-e-qubool hai, bad-diyanati nahi.

text.en: **Make a one-page timeline and put it on the wall.** Write milestones with dates and tick them off. Tell your clinic or family what you are doing so they can protect your writing time. Join or start a small writing group, because explaining progress to peers every week keeps momentum. Prepare for the viva by writing a one-minute summary of each chapter and the answers to "what are the limitations?" and "what would you do differently?".
text.ur: **Ek safha ki timeline banayein aur deewar par lagayein.** Sang-e-meel tareekhon ke saath likhein aur tick karte jayein. Apne clinic ya ghar walon ko batayein aap kya kar rahe hain taake woh aap ke likhne ka waqt bachayein. Chhota likhne ka group shamil hon ya shuru karein, kyunke har haftay saathiyon ko pesh-raft batana raftar qaim rakhta hai. Viva ke liye har chapter ka ek minute ka khulasa aur "hadein kya hain?" aur "aap kya mukhtalif karte?" ke jawab likh kar tayyari karein.

question.en: What is a viva or thesis defence really for?
question.ur: Viva ya thesis defence asal mein kis liye hota hai?

answer.en: Examiners want to check that the work is yours, that you understand it, and that you can discuss its strengths and limits honestly. It is a conversation between colleagues, not an attack. Candidates who know their thesis well, admit what they do not know, and explain what they would do differently usually do well. Practise out loud with a friend asking tough questions.
answer.ur: Examiners dekhna chahte hain ke kaam aap ka apna hai, aap isay samajhte hain, aur aap is ki khoobiyon aur hadon par imaandari se baat kar sakte hain. Yeh saathiyon ke beech baat cheet hai, hamla nahi. Jo ummeedwar apni thesis achhi tarah jaante hain, jo nahi jaante woh maan lete hain, aur batate hain ke woh kya mukhtalif karte, aam taur par achha karte hain. Dost se mushkil sawal poochhwa kar zor se mashq karein.

beats.patient: A final-year student realises, eight weeks before submission, that she has no analysis done and has not spoken to her supervisor for a month.
beats.assessment: The delay is serious but recoverable if she acts now, with honesty and a plan.
beats.treatment: She emails her supervisor for an urgent meeting, brings a one-page plan with a week-by-week schedule, agrees to send a chapter every Friday, and cuts a secondary question to protect the main one.
beats.reassess: She submits on time, with a smaller but sound thesis, and her supervisor agrees to help her turn one chapter into a paper.

text.en: **Look after yourself.** Long projects can bring stress, poor sleep and isolation. Take breaks, keep exercising, tell someone when you struggle, and use university support services. If you feel pressured to change results or to give authorship you do not agree with, speak to a senior person or the research integrity office; do not stay silent.
text.ur: **Apna khayal rakhein.** Lambay projects dabao, kharab neend aur tanhai la sakte hain. Waqfay lein, exercise jari rakhein, jab mushkil ho kisi ko batayein, aur university ki madad ki sehulatein istemal karein. Agar aap par nateeje badalne ya aisi musannifi dene ka dabao ho jis se aap mutafiq nahi to kisi senior shakhs ya research integrity ke daftar se baat karein; khamosh na rahein.

text.en: Phillips and Pugh's well-known guide to doctoral study stresses that students must manage their own projects, agree expectations with supervisors early, keep a regular schedule of meetings and writing, and treat the thesis as an exercise in showing independent, original, well-argued work. Lee's study of supervision found that supervisors work from different concepts, such as functional (project management), enculturation (joining the research community), critical thinking, emancipation and relationship building, so students benefit from discussing what each needs.
text.ur: Phillips aur Pugh ki doctoral study ki mashhoor rehnumai zor deti hai ke talba ko apne projects khud sambhalne, supervisors ke saath umeedein jaldi tay karne, mulaqaton aur likhne ka baqaida shedule rakhne, aur thesis ko azaad, asli, daleel se bharpoor kaam dikhane ki mashq samajhne chahiye. Lee ke supervision par study ne paya ke supervisors mukhtalif tasawwurat se kaam karte hain, jaise functional (project management), enculturation (research bradari mein shamil karna), critical thinking, emancipation aur rishta banana, isliye talba ko is baat se faida hota hai ke woh baat karein ke har ek ko kya chahiye.

text.en: **Backwards, Weekly, Written, Honest.** Plan backwards, write weekly, summarise meetings in writing, and stay honest about problems and data.
text.ur: **Peechay se, Haftawar, Likhit, Imaandar.** Peechay se plan, haftawar likhein, mulaqaton ka likhit khulasa, aur masail aur data ke baare mein imaandar rahein.

summary.en: Plan the thesis backwards from the deadline, write a little every week and keep three backups.
summary.ur: Thesis ka plan deadline se peechay ki taraf banayein, har haftay thora likhein aur teen backups rakhein.

summary.en: Run supervisor meetings with an agenda and a written summary, and agree authorship early in writing.
summary.ur: Supervisor ki mulaqatein agenda aur likhit khulase ke saath chalayein, aur musannifi jaldi likh kar tay karein.

summary.en: Use a reference manager, never fabricate data, and prepare for the viva as a conversation.
summary.ur: Reference manager istemal karein, data kabhi na gharein, aur viva ki tayyari baat cheet ke taur par karein.

back.ur: Deadline se peechay ki taraf, der ke liye ek mahine ke saath.

front.en: What goes in a supervisor meeting summary?
front.ur: Supervisor ki mulaqat ke khulase mein kya hota hai?

back.en: What was agreed, who does what, and by when.
back.ur: Kya tay hua, kaun kya karega, aur kab tak.

back.en: Early, in writing, and revisited as contributions change.
back.ur: Jaldi, likh kar, aur hissay badalne par dobara dekhi jaye.

back.en: To check the work is yours, you understand it, and you can discuss its limits honestly.
back.ur: Yeh dekhne ke liye ke kaam aap ka hai, aap samajhte hain, aur hadon par imaandari se baat kar sakte hain.
